entries.2cca79884b8bacf4: A reportable segment that, on consignment from shippers (export traders), prepares export documents and nego documents, packs export cargo, performs customs clearance, transports cargo to vessels at ports, delivers it locally, and carries out installation at delivery destinations and others. Operating revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥2,725 million. Equity-method affiliate Hanshin Container Transport Co., Ltd. handles ocean container transport, Mikasa Rikuun Co., Ltd. handles truck transport, and Hirose Sangyo Kaiun Co., Ltd. handles lighter transport.

entries.bbef0f75d141b3a5: Under the business concept 'Contribute to the world's industries and daily life through international logistics operations,' the company's basic policies include 'Provide high value-added services by solving customer challenges.' As a diversification of services, the company aims to strengthen its core business by enhancing and expanding the functions of its core port facilities, and to enter new businesses by utilizing group companies. To optimize management resources, the company is promoting DX, and plans to connect to the port-related data linkage platform 'CyberPort' and strengthen integration with its core systems. It provides international combined transport services that combine sea transport with the JR rail network, and plans to strengthen logistics functions through a modal shift. Overseas, centered on four overseas joint ventures including group companies, the company plans to strengthen its existing services and promote new product development.
